<description>
Prompted by https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36594#discussion_r4415881033.
</description>

<commits>
6a0a221271 doc: fix incorrect @param annotations

ab7b1abc62 doc: use doxygen comments for blocks containing @param

Plain /* comments are ignored by Doxygen and by clang's -Wdocumentation,
so mistakes in them go unnoticed. Also wrap the CoinGrinder ASCII trees
in @verbatim so Doxygen keeps their layout.

cbd28fa468 doc: use @param and @return in subprocess.h

b64432d28c doc: spell out escape sequences in doxygen comments

Doxygen interprets a backslash followed by a letter as a command, so
'\n' renders as a line break and '\t' etc. are unknown commands.

08b6dcba33 build: enable -Wdocumentation-pedantic

Catches misspelled doxygen commands such as '@peer[in]' (for
'@param[in]'), which -Wdocumentation alone does not report. i.e

```bash
../src/net_processing.cpp:717:8: warning: unknown command tag name [-Wdocumentation-unknown-command]
  717 |      * @peer[in] peer     The peer whose orphan transactions we will reconsider. Generally only
      |        ^~~~~
1 warning generated.
```
</commits>
